name: Fit CSA
summary: Fits the Constant Solid Angle (CSA) ODF model to DWI within a brain mask with DIPY dipy_fit_csa (1.1.1) and outputs peaks and derived metrics.
description: Runs dipy_fit_csa with --extract_pam_values, producing ODF peaks, spherical harmonic coefficients and scalar maps (for example GFA) from the CSA reconstruction. Use it to get fibre orientations for tractography or ODF-based metrics. Needs a DWI with bvals/bvecs and a brain mask.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvals and bvecs.

outputs.description: CSA peaks and metrics (peak directions and values, SH coefficients and scalar maps) from dipy_fit_csa.

parameters.description: Threshold used to find b=0 directions
Spherical harmonics order (default 6) used in the CSA fit.

Spherical harmonics order used for peak_from_model to compress
the ODF to spherical harmonics coefficients (default 8

citations.text: Garyfallidis E, et al. Dipy, a library for the analysis of diffusion MRI data. Front Neuroinform 8:8 (2014).
